label: MING IoT Pipeline
info:
Routes MQTT data to InfluxDB.
- Production: sensors/<device-id>/<measurement> and inference/<device-id>/result → 'raw_telemetry' bucket (30d)
- Sandbox: sandbox/* → 'sandbox' bucket

Uses InfluxDB Line Protocol via HTTP API (no contrib nodes needed).
Requires INFLUXDB_TOKEN env var in Node-RED container.

name: Production Pipeline → raw_telemetry bucket
info:
Routes sensors/<device-id>/<measurement> and inference/<device-id>/result topics to the 'raw_telemetry' InfluxDB bucket (30d retention).
Sensor readings go to the 'sensor_data' measurement, tagged with 'device' and 'sensor' from the topic.
Inference results go to the 'inference' measurement, tagged with 'device' from the topic.
Data is formatted as InfluxDB Line Protocol and sent via HTTP API.

name: Format for InfluxDB (iot)
Sandbox Pipeline → sandbox bucket
info:
Routes sandbox/* topics to the 'sandbox' InfluxDB bucket.
Strips 'sandbox/' prefix before determining measurement type, so sensor topics are sandbox/sensors/<device-id>/<measurement>.
Use 'make test-sandbox' to publish test data.
